description:
Configure JFrog Artifactory as a caching proxy for Maven Central and verify it works by caching a specific artifact.

1. Create a new Remote Repository with the Key 'central-proxy-test', Package Type 'Maven', and URL 'https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/'.
2. Use this new repository to download and cache the artifact 'org.apache.commons:commons-collections4:4.4'.
   - You can trigger the download by entering the full artifact URL into the browser address bar: http://localhost:8082/artifactory/central-proxy-test/org/apache/commons/commons-collections4/4.4/commons-collections4-4.4.jar
3. Verify in the Artifact Browser that the file 'commons-collections4-4.4.jar' is now stored/cached in the 'central-proxy-test' repository.
